Monsoon Arrives in Parts of India, Bringing Rain and Disruptions

Monsoon rains have entered parts of India, with some regions experiencing heavy downpours, thunderstorms, and waterlogging. While the rain offers relief to farmers, it has caused traffic disruptions and inconvenience to city dwellers in affected areas. Meanwhile, some outlets are highlighting the impact of their own reporting in prompting local authorities to address civic issues.
